map.采伐量=蓄积×采伐比例；保留蓄积=蓄积−采伐量；年均采伐量=采伐量÷回归年（采伐: Harvest volume = stock × harvest ratio; retained stock = stock − harvest volume; annual harvest = harvest volume ÷ recurrence year (harvest cycle). Intensity classes: <15% light, 15-25% moderate, 25-35% heavy, ≥35% very heavy. The block total = the per-hectare amount × area (ha).
map.每公顷蓄积 180 m³、采伐比例 25%、回归年 10 年、作业区 500 亩: Stock of 180 m³ per hectare, harvest ratio 25%, recurrence year 10, working block 500 mu (≈33.3 ha): harvest volume = 45 m³/ha, retained = 135 m³/ha, annual = 4.5 m³/ha·a, which counts as moderate harvesting; the block total harvest is about 1500 m³.
map.采伐强度上限多少？: What is the upper limit on harvest intensity?
map.抚育间伐一般不超 25%~30%、择伐不超 40%，且采伐后郁闭度不低于 0.6: Tending thinning generally stays within 25%-30% and selective harvest within 40%, and canopy closure after harvest must not drop below 0.6 so the stand can recover and stay ecologically stable.
map.年均允许采伐量怎么用？: How do I use the annual allowable harvest?
map.用于可持续经营配额的年度上限，作业区总量÷回归年得年均，避免超采；实际须纳入采伐: It serves as the annual ceiling for the sustainable management quota, with block total ÷ recurrence year giving the annual figure, which prevents over-harvesting. In practice it must go into the harvest quota and the operating design approval.
